AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 12544 project/scripts/align.mjs
// Script ↔ voice-over alignment without a speech recogniser, and script ↔ whisper word matching.
// Used by scripts/transcribe.mjs.
//
// alignScript(): the VO's speech segments (silence detection) are matched to the script's clauses by a global
// dynamic programme — every clause and every segment is used exactly once, in order, so an early mistake can
// not push later sentences off (no cumulative drift). A block of 1–6 clauses ↔ 1–6 segments costs how far its
// speaking rate (syllables per second) is from the narrator's local rate, plus penalties for sentence ends
// without a pause, long pauses inside a clause, and very short pauses at sentence ends. Breath / click segments
// can be skipped. Pass 1 uses the whole-VO rate, pass 2 the local rate around each block (slow dramatic
// passages and fast ones keep their own tempo). Inside a block words are placed by syllables over speech time.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";

const run = (cmd, a) => spawnSync(cmd, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });

export const probeDuration = (file) =>
  Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", file]).stdout.trim());

export function speechSegments(file, duration, noiseDb = -38, minSilence = 0.18) {
  const log = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", file, "-af", `silencedetect=n=${noiseDb}dB:d=${minSilence}`, "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const st = [...log.matchAll(/silence_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const en = [...log.matchAll(/silence_end: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
  const segs = [];
  let cur = 0;
  st.forEach((s, i) => { if (s - cur > 0.06) segs.push([cur, s]); cur = en[i] ?? duration; });
  if (duration - cur > 0.06) segs.push([cur, duration]);
  return segs;
}

// ── Indonesian text helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const ONES = ["", "satu", "dua", "tiga", "empat", "lima", "enam", "tujuh", "delapan", "sembilan"];
export function numberWords(n) {
  n = Math.floor(n);
  if (n === 0) return "nol";
  if (n < 10) return ONES[n];
  if (n === 10) return "sepuluh";
  if (n === 11) return "sebelas";
  if (n < 20) return `${ONES[n - 10]} belas`;
  if (n < 100) return `${ONES[Math.floor(n / 10)]} puluh ${ONES[n % 10]}`.trim();
  if (n < 200) return `seratus ${n % 100 ? numberWords(n % 100) : ""}`.trim();
  if (n < 1000) return `${ONES[Math.floor(n / 100)]} ratus ${n % 100 ? numberWords(n % 100) : ""}`.trim();
  if (n < 2000) return `seribu ${n % 1000 ? numberWords(n % 1000) : ""}`.trim();
  if (n < 1e6) return `${numberWords(Math.floor(n / 1000))} ribu ${n % 1000 ? numberWords(n % 1000) : ""}`.trim();
  return `${numberWords(Math.floor(n / 1e6))} juta ${n % 1e6 ? numberWords(n % 1e6) : ""}`.trim();
}
// "02.13" → "dua tiga belas", "500" → "lima ratus", "13:00" → "tiga belas nol"
const spellDigits = (w) => w.replace(/\d+/g, (d) => ` ${numberWords(Number(d))} `);

export function syllables(token) {
  const raw = token.replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu, "");
  if (!raw) return 0;
  if (/^\p{Lu}{2,6}$/u.test(raw)) return raw.length; // acronyms read letter by letter (CCTV, KTP)
  let total = 0;
  for (const part of spellDigits(token.toLowerCase()).split(/[^a-zà-ÿ]+/).filter(Boolean)) {
    const v = (part.match(/[aeiouéè]/g) || []).length;
    const diph = (part.match(/(ai|au|oi|ei)(?=[^aeiou]|$)/g) || []).length;
    total += Math.max(1, v - diph);
  }
  return Math.max(1, total);
}

export const norm = (w) => spellDigits(w.toLowerCase()).replace(/[^\p{L}\s]/gu, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

// tokens with the pause strength after each: 2 = sentence end / paragraph / ellipsis, 1 = comma-like, 0 = none
export function tokenize(text) {
  const out = [];
  const lines = text.replace(/\r/g, "").split("\n");
  lines.forEach((line, li) => {
    const toks = line.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    toks.forEach((t, i) => {
      let p = 0;
      if (/(\.\.\.|…)["”'’)]*$/.test(t) || /[.?!]["”'’)]*$/.test(t)) p = 2;
      else if (/[,;:—–]["”'’)]*$/.test(t) || /^[—–]$/.test(t)) p = 1;
      if (i === toks.length - 1 && li < lines.length - 1) p = Math.max(p, 2); // end of a script line
      out.push({ w: t, p, syl: syllables(t) });
    });
  });
  // a dash on its own carries no sound: fold it into the previous token's pause
  return out.filter((t, i, a) => { if (t.syl > 0) return true; if (i > 0) a[i - 1].p = Math.max(a[i - 1].p, t.p); return false; });
}

export function clausesOf(toks) {
  const cl = [];
  let cur = [];
  for (const t of toks) { cur.push(t); if (t.p > 0) { cl.push({ toks: cur, syl: cur.reduce((s, x) => s + x.syl, 0), end: t.p }); cur = []; } }
  if (cur.length) cl.push({ toks: cur, syl: cur.reduce((s, x) => s + x.syl, 0), end: 2 });
  return cl;
}

// ── the aligner ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every speech segment receives a contiguous run of words (a pause never falls inside a word); a very short
// segment may receive none (breath, click). Cost of a segment = how far its rate is from the narrator's local
// rate (a phrase end is lengthened, so a constant is added to the expected time) + the cost of the pause that
// follows it (cheap after a sentence end, dearer after a comma, dear in the middle of a clause, more so the
// longer the pause) + the punctuation the narrator ran through without pausing.
const MAXW = 40, TAIL = 0.12;
const SKIP = [0, 0.08, 0.9]; // ran through: nothing, a comma, a sentence end / ellipsis
function solve(toks, segs, rateAt) {
  const N = toks.length, M = segs.length;
  const dur = segs.map(([a, b]) => b - a);
  const gapAfter = segs.map((s, j) => (j + 1 < M ? segs[j + 1][0] - s[1] : 9));
  const pre = [0]; for (const t of toks) pre.push(pre.at(-1) + t.syl);
  const skp = [0]; for (const t of toks) skp.push(skp.at(-1) + SKIP[t.p]);
  const INF = 1e18;
  const f = Array.from({ length: M + 1 }, () => new Float64Array(N + 1).fill(INF));
  const bk = Array.from({ length: M + 1 }, () => new Int32Array(N + 1).fill(-1));
  f[0][0] = 0;
  for (let j = 0; j < M; j++) {
    const R = rateAt(segs[j][0], segs[j][1]), g = gapAfter[j];
    for (let i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
      const base = f[j][i];
      if (base >= INF) continue;
      if (dur[j] < 0.45) { const c = base + 1.2 + 10 * dur[j]; if (c < f[j + 1][i]) { f[j + 1][i] = c; bk[j + 1][i] = i; } }
      for (let k = i + 1; k <= N && k - i <= MAXW; k++) {
        const sy = pre[k] - pre[i];
        const lr = Math.log(dur[j] / (sy / R + TAIL));
        const p = toks[k - 1].p;
        // the pause after this segment ends at word k-1 (none after the last segment)
        let pc = 0;
        if (j < M - 1) pc = p === 2 ? Math.max(0, 0.3 - g) * 3 : p === 1 ? 0.25 : 1.3 + 1.2 * Math.max(0, Math.min(g, 2) - 0.4);
        const c = base + 2.2 * lr * lr * Math.sqrt(sy) + pc + (skp[k - 1] - skp[i]);
        if (c < f[j + 1][k]) { f[j + 1][k] = c; bk[j + 1][k] = i; }
      }
    }
  }
  if (f[M][N] >= INF) return null;
  const groups = new Array(M);
  for (let j = M, k = N; j > 0; j--) { const i = bk[j][k]; groups[j - 1] = [i, k]; k = i; }
  return { groups, cost: f[M][N] };
}

function localRate(toks, segs, groups, fallback) {
  // syllables per second of the solved segments, smoothed over ±18 s
  const pts = groups.map(([i, k], j) => ({ t: (segs[j][0] + segs[j][1]) / 2, sy: toks.slice(i, k).reduce((s, t) => s + t.syl, 0), sp: Math.max(0.05, segs[j][1] - segs[j][0] - TAIL) })).filter((p) => p.sy > 0);
  return (t0, t1) => {
    const t = (t0 + t1) / 2;
    let sy = 0, sp = 0;
    for (const p of pts) { const w = Math.exp(-(((p.t - t) / 18) ** 2)); sy += w * p.sy; sp += w * p.sp; }
    return sp > 1 ? sy / sp : fallback;
  };
}

export function alignScript(text, segs) {
  const toks = tokenize(text);
  if (!segs.length || !toks.length) return null;
  const totSyl = toks.reduce((s, t) => s + t.syl, 0);
  const totSp = segs.reduce((s, [a, b]) => s + Math.max(0.05, b - a - TAIL), 0);
  const R0 = totSyl / totSp;
  let sol = solve(toks, segs, () => R0);
  if (!sol) return null;
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) { const s2 = solve(toks, segs, localRate(toks, segs, sol.groups, R0)); if (s2) sol = s2; }
  const rate = localRate(toks, segs, sol.groups, R0);
  const words = [], warnings = [];
  sol.groups.forEach(([i, k], j) => {
    if (k === i) return;
    const ts = toks.slice(i, k), [x, y] = segs[j];
    const sy = ts.reduce((s, t) => s + t.syl, 0), sp = y - x;
    let u = 0;
    for (const t of ts) { words.push([t.w, x + (sp * u) / sy, x + (sp * (u + t.syl)) / sy]); u += t.syl; }
    const dev = Math.log(sp / (sy / rate(x, y) + TAIL));
    if (Math.abs(dev) > 0.6 && sy >= 6) warnings.push(`${x.toFixed(1)} s "${ts.slice(0, 5).map((t) => t.w).join(" ")}…" is spoken ${dev < 0 ? "much faster" : "much slower"} than the rest — look at this line on the stills`);
  });
  for (let k = 1; k < words.length; k++) if (words[k][1] < words[k - 1][2]) words[k][1] = words[k - 1][2];
  return { words, warnings, clauses: clausesOf(toks).length, segments: segs.length, rate: R0 };
}

// ── script words with whisper timings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Keeps the script's spelling (names, numbers as written) and takes the time of each word from whisper,
// matched by an edit-distance alignment of the normalised word streams; unmatched script words are
// interpolated between their matched neighbours.
export function scriptOnWhisper(text, hyp) {
  const toks = tokenize(text);
  const sw = toks.map((t) => norm(t.w));
  // whisper may write "13" for "tiga belas": expand both sides to single words for matching
  const S = [], sIdx = [];
  sw.forEach((w, i) => w.split(" ").filter(Boolean).forEach((p) => { S.push(p); sIdx.push(i); }));
  const H = [], hIdx = [];
  hyp.forEach(([w], i) => norm(w).split(" ").filter(Boolean).forEach((p) => { H.push(p); hIdx.push(i); }));
  const n = S.length, m = H.length;
  const D = Array.from({ length: n + 1 }, (_, i) => Int32Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, (_, j) => (i === 0 ? j : j === 0 ? i : 0)));
  const near = (a, b) => a === b || (a.length > 3 && b.length > 3 && (a.startsWith(b) || b.startsWith(a)));
  for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) for (let j = 1; j <= m; j++)
    D[i][j] = Math.min(D[i - 1][j] + 1, D[i][j - 1] + 1, D[i - 1][j - 1] + (near(S[i - 1], H[j - 1]) ? 0 : 1));
  const startOf = new Array(toks.length).fill(null), endOf = new Array(toks.length).fill(null);
  let i = n, j = m, matched = 0;
  while (i > 0 && j > 0) {
    if (D[i][j] === D[i - 1][j - 1] + (near(S[i - 1], H[j - 1]) ? 0 : 1)) {
      if (near(S[i - 1], H[j - 1])) {
        const ti = sIdx[i - 1], h = hyp[hIdx[j - 1]];
        startOf[ti] = startOf[ti] === null ? h[1] : Math.min(startOf[ti], h[1]);
        endOf[ti] = endOf[ti] === null ? h[2] : Math.max(endOf[ti], h[2]);
        matched++;
      }
      i--; j--;
    } else if (D[i][j] === D[i - 1][j] + 1) i--; else j--;
  }
  const words = toks.map((t, k) => [t.w, startOf[k], endOf[k]]);
  // interpolate the unmatched words by syllables between matched neighbours
  for (let k = 0; k < words.length; k++) {
    if (words[k][1] !== null) continue;
    let a = k - 1; while (a >= 0 && words[a][1] === null) a--;
    let b = k; while (b < words.length && words[b][1] === null) b++;
    const t0 = a >= 0 ? words[a][2] : (b < words.length ? Math.max(0, words[b][1] - 0.4) : 0);
    const t1 = b < words.length ? words[b][1] : t0 + 0.4 * (b - a);
    const run = toks.slice(a + 1, b), tot = run.reduce((s, t) => s + t.syl, 0) || 1;
    let u = 0;
    run.forEach((t, r) => { words[a + 1 + r][1] = t0 + ((t1 - t0) * u) / tot; u += t.syl; words[a + 1 + r][2] = t0 + ((t1 - t0) * u) / tot; });
    k = b - 1;
  }
  for (const w of words) if (w[2] < w[1] + 0.06) w[2] = w[1] + 0.06; // whisper gives some words zero length
  for (let k = 1; k < words.length; k++) if (words[k][1] < words[k - 1][1]) words[k][1] = words[k - 1][1];
  return { words, matched: matched / Math.max(1, n) };
}

==== 19298 project/scripts/analyze.mjs
// Story analyzer: script + word-timed VO → what the story needs, before any world or story.json is written.
//   node scripts/analyze.mjs stories/<id> [--lexicon=library/lexicon-id.json]
// Reads stories/<id>/script.txt and words.json ([word, t0, t1] in VO seconds). Writes
//   stories/<id>/analysis.json   sentences with times + pauses, suggested scene cuts, and the story read in
//                                context (scripts/story-nlp.mjs): time of day with its evidence and the story's
//                                clock, location + areas, characters (named, roles, figures, a double), who does
//                                what to which object and whether it is acted / on a screen / dialogue / written /
//                                hypothetical / negated, state changes of things, sounds, dialogue and written text
//   stories/<id>/REQUIREMENTS.md what can be reused (worlds, library objects, looks, actions, SFX), what must be
//                                generated (world, objects from primitives) and what is not supported
// Words the lexicon does not know are still listed ("unlisted things"), so read the report, not only the tables.

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { analyzeStory } from "./story-nlp.mjs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const dir = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!dir || !fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "words.json"))) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/analyze.mjs stories/<id>   (needs script.txt and words.json there)");
  process.exit(1);
}
const id = path.basename(dir);
const LEX = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(opt("lexicon", "library/lexicon-id.json"), "utf8"));
const words = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, "words.json"), "utf8")).map((w) => (Array.isArray(w) ? w : [w.w ?? w.word, w.t0 ?? w.start, w.t1 ?? w.end]));
const script = fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, "script.txt")) ? fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, "script.txt"), "utf8") : words.map((w) => w[0]).join(" ");
const r2 = (x) => Math.round(x * 100) / 100;

// ── sentences, pauses, paragraphs ─────────────────────────────────────────
const sentences = [];
let cur = null;
words.forEach(([w, t0, t1], i) => {
  if (!cur) cur = { i: sentences.length, text: "", t0, t1, w0: i, w1: i };
  cur.text += (cur.text ? " " : "") + w;
  cur.t1 = t1; cur.w1 = i;
  if (/[.!?…]["”']?$/.test(w) || i === words.length - 1) { sentences.push(cur); cur = null; }
});
sentences.forEach((s, k) => {
  s.pauseAfter = r2((sentences[k + 1]?.t0 ?? s.t1) - s.t1);
  s.t0 = r2(s.t0); s.t1 = r2(s.t1);
  s.cue = words[s.w0][0].replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}-]/gu, "");
});
const pauses = [];
for (let i = 1; i < words.length; i++) { const g = words[i][1] - words[i - 1][2]; if (g >= 0.3) pauses.push({ after: words[i - 1][0], before: words[i][0], at: r2(words[i - 1][2]), len: r2(g) }); }
const paras = script.split(/\n\s*\n/).map((p) => p.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const perPara = paras.map((p) => p.split(/(?<=[.!?…]["”]?)\s+/).filter((x) => /\p{L}/u.test(x)).length);
const paraOk = perPara.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) === sentences.length;
let k0 = 0;
const paraOf = [];
if (paraOk) perPara.forEach((n, pi) => { for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) paraOf[k0 + k] = pi; k0 += n; });
// Scene cuts: paragraphs when the script has real multi-sentence paragraphs; otherwise the narrator's long pauses
// and turn words ("Tapi", "Tiba-tiba", "Sore itu", "Beberapa detik kemudian"), kept between ~6 and ~25 s.
// (an ellipsis is a pause, not a sentence end, when judging whether paragraphs hold several sentences)
const fullStops = paras.map((p) => p.split(/(?<=[^.][.!?]["”]?)\s+(?=["“]?\p{Lu})/u).filter((x) => /\p{L}/u.test(x)).length);
const multi = paraOk && fullStops.filter((n) => n > 1).length >= Math.max(2, paras.length / 3);
const gaps = sentences.slice(0, -1).map((s) => s.pauseAfter).sort((a, b) => a - b);
const longGap = Math.max(0.8, gaps[Math.floor(gaps.length * 0.7)] ?? 0.8);
const TURN = /^(tapi|namun|tiba-tiba|lalu|kemudian|sementara|keesokan|beberapa|sore|malam|pagi|siang|subuh|dan|padahal|kali|saat|ketika)$/i;
const scenes = [];
sentences.forEach((s, k) => {
  if (k === 0) return scenes.push({ at: s.cue, t0: s.t0, sentences: [k], why: "start" });
  const last = scenes.at(-1), len = s.t0 - last.t0, gap = sentences[k - 1].pauseAfter;
  let why = null;
  const startsSentence = /^["“]?\p{Lu}/u.test(words[s.w0][0]); // never cut inside a sentence ("…dua pagi... jangan …")
  if (!startsSentence) why = null;
  else if (multi) { if (paraOf[k] !== paraOf[k - 1]) why = "paragraph break in the script"; }
  else if (len >= 6 && gap >= longGap) why = `pause ${gap}s before it`;
  else if (len >= 6 && gap >= 0.6 && TURN.test(s.cue)) why = `turn word “${s.cue}” after a ${gap}s pause`;
  else if (len >= 25 && gap >= 0.45) why = `the scene is ${Math.round(len)} s long`;
  if (why) scenes.push({ at: s.cue, t0: s.t0, sentences: [k], why }); else last.sentences.push(k);
});

// ── the story in context ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const S = analyzeStory(script, words, LEX);

// ── requirements: reuse / generate / unsupported ──────────────────────────
const ls = (d, ext) => (fs.existsSync(d) ? fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(ext)).map((f) => path.join(d, f)) : []);
const objDirs = ["assets/objects", path.join(dir, "objects"), "library/objects"];
const objFile = (oid) => objDirs.map((d) => path.join(d, `${oid}.json`)).find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
const BUILTIN = ["tree-pine", "tree-broad", "tree-palm", "bush", "fern", "rock", "log", "grass-tuft"];
const PROPS = ["phone", "binoculars", "lantern", "flashlight", "mug", "book"];
const ACTIONS = ["stand", "look", "turn", "walk", "run", "startle", "freeze", "peer", "point", "reach", "wave", "phone", "binoculars", "raise", "think", "nod", "shake", "sigh", "talk", "shiver", "sit", "standUp", "write", "lie", "sleep", "wake", "sitUp", "push", "pickUp", "putDown", "give", "receive", "open", "close", "kneel", "pickUp+putDown"];
const looksSrc = fs.existsSync("src/cine/character/looks.ts") ? fs.readFileSync("src/cine/character/looks.ts", "utf8") : "";
const LOOKS = [...looksSrc.matchAll(/^ {2}"?([a-z][a-z-]*)"?: \{/gm)].map((m) => m[1]);
const sfxSrc = fs.existsSync("scripts/sound-story.ts") ? fs.readFileSync("scripts/sound-story.ts", "utf8") : "";
const SFX = [...sfxSrc.matchAll(/case "([a-z-]+)":/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
const BUILTIN_WORLDS = { kos: "built-in world 'kos' (boarding house: room, corridor, stairs, yard)", coast: "built-in world 'coast' (lighthouse, beach, sea)" };
const worldFiles = [...ls("worlds", ".world.json"), ...ls("library/worlds", ".world.json"), ...(fs.existsSync("stories") ? fs.readdirSync("stories", { withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isDirectory()).flatMap((e) => ls(path.join("stories", e.name), ".world.json")) : [])];
const worldDocs = worldFiles.map((f) => { try { const w = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")); return { file: f, id: w.id, doc: w.doc ?? "" }; } catch { return null; } }).filter(Boolean);
const KIND_WORDS = { hospital: ["hospital", "ward", "clinic"], corridor: ["corridor"], market: ["market", "stall"], forest: ["forest", "track", "camp"], school: ["school", "classroom"], office: ["office"], house: ["house", "home", "room", "kitchen"], street: ["street", "road", "sidewalk"], coast: ["coast", "beach", "lighthouse"], kos: ["kos", "boarding"], shop: ["shop", "store", "kiosk"], library: ["library", "reading"], park: ["park"] };
const kinds = Object.entries(S.location.kinds).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).filter(([, w], i, all) => w >= 1 && w >= all[0][1] * 0.5).map(([k]) => k);
const worldReq = kinds.map((k) => {
  if (BUILTIN_WORLDS[k]) return { kind: k, status: "reuse", use: BUILTIN_WORLDS[k] };
  // best match, not the first: the kind's main word counts most ("house" beats a passing "room")
  const words = KIND_WORDS[k] ?? [k];
  const score = (d) => words.reduce((n, x, i) => n + (new RegExp(`\\b${x}`).test(d.doc.toLowerCase()) ? (i === 0 ? 3 : 1) : 0), 0);
  const w = worldDocs.map((d) => ({ d, s: score(d) })).filter((x) => x.s > 0).sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s)[0]?.d;
  return w ? { kind: k, status: "reuse-or-adapt", use: w.file, note: w.doc } : { kind: k, status: "generate", use: `write ${id}.world.json (${k}): rooms/ground/paths/objects/scatter/lights + places with marks` };
});
const objReq = [];
for (const o of [...S.objects].sort((a, b) => Number(b.used) - Number(a.used))) {
  const [kind, name] = o.value.includes(":") ? o.value.split(/:(.*)/s) : ["library", o.value];
  let status, note;
  if (kind === "library") { const f = objFile(name); status = f ? "reuse" : "generate"; note = f ? f : `library id "${name}" missing — author it`; }
  else if (kind === "builtin") { status = BUILTIN.includes(name) ? "reuse" : "generate"; note = `built-in ${name}`; }
  else if (kind === "prop") { status = PROPS.includes(name) ? "reuse" : "unsupported"; note = `held prop "${name}" (cast "prop")`; }
  else if (kind === "world") { status = "world"; note = `made by the world DSL (${name})`; }
  else if (kind === "ui") { status = "ui"; note = `${name}: show as a screen / card insert (ui card, text, a cut to a full-frame view) — screens cannot show live pictures`; }
  else if (kind === "look") { status = "look"; note = `${name} on a person: choose the look / custom colours (references/cinestory/characters.md); accessories the rig lacks are said, not shown`; }
  else if (kind === "generate") { status = "generate"; note = `no library object for "${name}" — build from primitives into assets/objects/<id>.json, check it on the object sheet`; }
  else { status = "complex"; note = `"${name}" is too organic/detailed for primitives — needs a model asset, an agreed simplified stand-in, or keep it off screen (do NOT silently substitute)`; }
  objReq.push({ word: o.word, t: o.mentions[0], mentions: o.mentions.length, story: o.used, need: name, status, note });
}
const acted = S.interactions.filter((i) => i.mode === "acted" || i.mode === "state");
const actReq = acted.map((a) => ({ t: a.t, word: a.word, who: a.who, action: a.action, obj: a.obj, with: a.with, target: a.target, mode: a.mode, status: a.supported === false ? "unsupported" : ACTIONS.includes(a.action) ? "supported" : "unsupported" }));
const notActed = S.interactions.filter((i) => !(i.mode === "acted" || i.mode === "state"));
const lookFor = (p) => p.look ?? (p.kind === "figure" && p.double ? `same look as ${p.double.of}` : undefined);
const lookReq = [...S.characters.map((c) => ({ who: c.name, look: lookFor(c) })), ...S.unnamed.map((u) => ({ who: u.id, look: lookFor(u), double: u.double }))].map((x) => ({ ...x, status: x.look && (LOOKS.includes(x.look) || x.look.startsWith("same look")) ? "reuse" : "choose" }));
const sfxReq = S.sounds.map((s) => ({ word: s.word, t: s.t, sfx: s.sfx, status: SFX.includes(s.sfx) ? "available" : "missing" }));

const analysis = {
  id, vo: { words: words.length, start: r2(words[0][1]), end: r2(words.at(-1)[2]) },
  sentences: sentences.map(({ i, text, t0, t1, pauseAfter, cue }) => ({ i, text, t0, t1, pauseAfter, cue, para: paraOk ? paraOf[i] : undefined })),
  pauses, scenes: scenes.map((s) => ({ ...s, text: s.sentences.map((k) => sentences[k].text).join(" ") })),
  protagonist: S.protagonist, explanation: S.explanation, unmapped: S.unmapped, characters: S.characters, unnamed: S.unnamed, time: S.time, location: S.location,
  objects: S.objects, mentions: S.mentions, interactions: S.interactions, states: S.states, sounds: S.sounds, emotions: S.emotions, dialogue: S.dialogue, texts: S.texts,
  requirements: { implied: LEX.implied?.[S.location.main] ?? [], world: worldReq, time: S.time.stated ? S.time.value : "day (nothing said — decide from the story)", clock: S.time.clocks.find((c) => !c.rule)?.clock, objects: objReq, actions: actReq, looks: lookReq, sfx: sfxReq },
};
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "analysis.json"), JSON.stringify(analysis, null, 1));

const who = (w) => (w ?? "?").replace(/^role:/, "");
const md = [
  `# Requirements — ${id}`, "",
  `VO ${analysis.vo.start}–${analysis.vo.end} s · ${sentences.length} sentences · ${scenes.length} suggested scenes · time: **${analysis.requirements.time}**${analysis.requirements.clock ? ` · clock ${analysis.requirements.clock}` : ""} · place: **${S.location.main ?? "?"}**`, "",
  "## Time of day", "", ...(S.time.evidence.length ? S.time.evidence.map((e) => `- ${e}`) : ["- nothing in the script says it — decide from the story"]), ...S.time.ignored.map((e) => `- ignored: ${e}`), ...S.time.clocks.map((c) => `- clock ${c.t}s “${c.text}” → **${c.clock}**${c.rule ? " (a rule / not now)" : ""}`), "",
  "## Location", "", `- main: **${S.location.main ?? "?"}** (${Object.entries(S.location.kinds).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${Math.round(v * 10) / 10}`).join(", ")})`, ...S.location.areas.map((a) => `- area: ${a.name} (${a.kind}, first at ${a.t}s)`), "",
  "## World", "", ...(worldReq.length ? worldReq.map((w) => `- ${w.kind}: **${w.status}** — ${w.use}`) : ["- no place found — decide from the script"]), "",
  "Ready-made worlds in this project (reuse or adapt a copy before writing a new one; `node scripts/worlds.mjs <id>` lists places, marks, seats and props):", "",
  ...Object.entries(BUILTIN_WORLDS).map(([k, v]) => `- \`${k}\` — ${v}`), ...worldDocs.map((d) => `- \`${d.id}\` (${d.file}) — ${d.doc}`), "",
  "## Characters", "", ...(S.characters.length + S.unnamed.length ? [
    ...S.characters.map((c) => `- **${c.name}**${c.role ? ` (${c.role})` : ""}${c.name === S.protagonist ? " — protagonist" : ""} — ${c.mentions.length} mentions from ${c.mentions[0]}s`),
    ...S.unnamed.map((u) => `- ${u.kind === "figure" ? `a figure (“${u.role}”)` : `unnamed ${u.role}`} — from ${u.mentions[0]}s${u.double ? ` — **a double of ${u.double.of}** (${u.double.evidence.join(", ")}): same look` : ""}`)] : ["- none found (pronouns only? read the script)"]), "",
  "## Objects (story objects first)", "", "| word | needs | status | story object | note |", "|---|---|---|---|---|", ...objReq.map((o) => `| ${o.word} (${o.t}s, ×${o.mentions}) | ${o.need} | **${o.status}** | ${o.story ? "yes" : ""} | ${o.note} |`), "",
  ...((LEX.implied?.[S.location.main] ?? []).length ? [`## Implied by the place (${S.location.main}) — dress the set, the script does not name them`, "", ...LEX.implied[S.location.main].map((x) => `- ${x}`), ""] : []),
  ...(S.mentions.length ? ["## Unlisted things (not in the lexicon — decide: build, world, or ignore)", "", ...S.mentions.map((m) => `- ${m.t}s **${m.word}** — “${m.context}”`), ""] : []),
  "## Interactions — acted on screen", "", ...(actReq.length ? actReq.map((a) => `- ${a.t}s “${a.word}” → **${who(a.who)}: ${a.action}**${a.obj ? ` ${a.obj}` : ""}${a.with ? ` with ${a.with}` : ""}${a.target ? ` → ${a.target}` : ""}${a.mode === "state" ? " (a pose, not a movement)" : ""}${a.status === "unsupported" ? " — **unsupported**: stage around it" : ""}`) : ["- none"]), "",

  "## Not acted (do NOT stage these as actions)", "", ...(notActed.length ? notActed.map((a) => `- ${a.t}s “${a.word}” (${who(a.who)}: ${a.action}) — ${{ "on-screen": "seen on a screen / photo: show it in that view", dialogue: "said in dialogue", written: "written text: show as an insert / card", hypothetical: "a rule / an 'if' / 'as if'", negated: "negated", said: "a rule or words handed over, not an object", "unclear who": "who does it is not said (heard in the dark?)", "non-cast": "done by an animal / thing: off screen or by sound" }[a.mode] ?? a.mode}`) : ["- none"]), "",

  "## Dialogue and written text", "", ...(S.dialogue.length + S.texts.length ? [...S.dialogue.map((d) => `- ${d.t}s said by **${who(d.speaker)}**: “${d.text}” → a \`talk\` beat`), ...S.texts.map((d) => `- ${d.t}s written on **${d.on}**: “${d.text}” → insert / ui card`)] : ["- none"]), "",
  "## Sounds", "", ...(sfxReq.length ? sfxReq.map((s) => `- ${s.t}s “${s.word}” → ${s.sfx} (${s.status})`) : ["- none"]), "",
  "## Emotions", "", ...(S.emotions.length ? S.emotions.map((e) => `- ${e.t}s “${e.word}” → face ${e.face}${e.who ? ` (${who(e.who)})` : ""}`) : ["- none"]), "",
  "## Looks", "", ...lookReq.map((l) => `- ${who(l.who)}: ${l.look ?? "?"} (${l.status})`), "",
  "## Scenes (cue → text)", "", ...analysis.scenes.map((s) => `- **${s.t0}s "${s.at}"** (${s.why}): ${s.text}`), "",
  "## Pauses to keep (≥ 0.3 s)", "", ...(pauses.length ? pauses.map((p) => `- ${p.at}s, ${p.len}s after "${p.after}"`) : ["- none"]), "",
  "Read in context (quotes, conditions, negation, screens, pronouns), but it is still a reading aid: check the interactions against the script before directing.", "",
].join("\n");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "REQUIREMENTS.md"), md);

const count = (arr, st) => arr.filter((x) => x.status === st).length;
console.log(`${id}: ${sentences.length} sentences, ${scenes.length} scenes, ${pauses.length} pauses ≥0.3 s`);

==== 3812 project/scripts/check-env.mjs
// Environment check before any AI BIJAN render. Prints a plain report and exits non-zero only
// when something required is missing. Installs nothing.
//   node scripts/check-env.mjs

import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";

const rows = [];
const add = (name, ok, detail, required = true) => rows.push({ name, ok, detail, required });

const [maj, min] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number);
// 22.18+ runs the .ts helper scripts directly (type stripping on by default)
add("Node.js ≥ 22.18", maj > 22 || (maj === 22 && min >= 18), `found ${process.versions.node}`);

const has = (cmd, args = ["-version"]) => {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, args, { encoding: "utf8" });
  return r.status === 0 ? (r.stdout || r.stderr).split("\n")[0].trim() : null;
};
const npmV = has(process.platform === "win32" ? "npm.cmd" : "npm", ["-v"]);
add("npm", !!npmV, npmV ?? "not found");
const ff = has("ffmpeg");
add("ffmpeg (audio analysis, contact sheets, final audio)", !!ff, ff ? ff.slice(0, 60) : "not found — rendering still works, VO analysis/delivery does not");
const fp = has("ffprobe");
add("ffprobe", !!fp, fp ? "ok" : "not found");

// optional: real word timings (whisper.cpp) and offline narration (macOS `say`)
const whisperCli = [process.env.WHISPER_CLI, spawnSync("sh", ["-c", "command -v whisper-cli"], { encoding: "utf8" }).stdout?.trim(), "/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli", "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli"].filter(Boolean).find((c) => fs.existsSync(c));
const modelDirs = [`${os.homedir()}/.cache/whisper.cpp`, "models", "/opt/homebrew/share/whisper-cpp"];
const whisperModel = (process.env.WHISPER_MODEL && fs.existsSync(process.env.WHISPER_MODEL) && process.env.WHISPER_MODEL) || modelDirs.flatMap((d) => (fs.existsSync(d) ? fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".bin")).map((f) => `${d}/${f}`) : []))[0];
add("whisper.cpp (exact word timing from any VO)", !!(whisperCli && whisperModel), whisperCli && whisperModel ? `${whisperCli} + ${whisperModel.split("/").pop()}` : `${whisperCli ? "model" : "whisper-cli"} not found — without it the VO script text is needed (timing ≈0.3 s less precise)`, false);
const say = process.platform === "darwin" && spawnSync("say", ["-v", "?"], { encoding: "utf8" }).stdout?.includes("id_ID");
add("Offline Indonesian narration (macOS say, voice Damayanti)", !!say, say ? "available (used only with the user's approval)" : "not available — bring a recorded VO", false);

let freeGb = null;
try {
  const st = fs.statfsSync(process.cwd());
  freeGb = (st.bavail * st.bsize) / 1e9;
} catch {}
add("Free disk ≥ 5 GB", freeGb === null ? true : freeGb >= 5, freeGb === null ? "unknown" : `${freeGb.toFixed(1)} GB free`);
add("RAM", true, `${(os.totalmem() / 1e9).toFixed(0)} GB total`, false);

const plat = { darwin: "macOS (recommended)", win32: "Windows: run npm run smoke to confirm 3D rendering", linux: "Linux: run npm run smoke; without a GPU use GL=swangle (slow)" }[process.platform] ?? process.platform;
add("Platform", true, plat, false);

const deps = fs.existsSync("node_modules/remotion") && fs.existsSync("node_modules/three");
add("Project packages installed (npm ci)", deps, deps ? "ok" : "run: npm ci", false);
let browser = false;
try {
  browser = fs.readdirSync("node_modules/.remotion").some((d) => d.includes("chrome"));
} catch {}
add("Remotion headless browser downloaded", browser, browser ? "ok" : "downloads automatically on first render (~100–200 MB)", false);

for (const r of rows) console.log(`${r.ok ? "✓" : r.required ? "✗" : "!"} ${r.name}: ${r.detail}`);
const missing = rows.filter((r) => r.required && !r.ok);
console.log(missing.length ? `\n${missing.length} required item(s) missing.` : "\nReady.");
process.exit(missing.length ? 1 : 0);

==== 2500 project/scripts/deliver.mjs
// Delivery master: measure integrated loudness, apply gain + a true limiter so the file
// lands at the target without clipping, copy the video stream untouched, then verify.
//   node scripts/deliver.mjs <in.mp4> <out.mp4> [targetLUFS=-14] [ceilingDb=-2]
// (loudnorm alone can't stop AAC inter-sample overshoot; a limiter before the encoder can.)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";

const [input, output, targetArg = "-14", ceilArg = "-2"] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!input || !output) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/deliver.mjs <in.mp4> <out.mp4> [targetLUFS] [ceilingDb]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const target = Number(targetArg);
const ceiling = 10 ** (Number(ceilArg) / 20);

const ffmpeg = (args) => {
  const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", args, { encoding: "utf8" });
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(r.stderr);
  return r.stderr;
};

/** ebur128 prints its summary to stderr. */
const loudness = (file) => {
  const log = ffmpeg(["-nostats", "-i", file, "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"]);
  const s = log.slice(log.lastIndexOf("Summary"));
  return {
    I: Number(/I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS/.exec(s)?.[1]),
    peak: Number(/Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS/.exec(s)?.[1]),
  };
};

const before = loudness(input);
let gain = target - before.I + 0.4; // the limiter shaves a little; aim slightly high
let after;
// Peaky voices make the limiter eat more than expected, so measure and correct (max 5 passes).
for (let pass = 1; pass <= 5; pass++) {
  ffmpeg([
    "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", input, "-c:v", "copy",
    "-af", `volume=${gain.toFixed(2)}dB,alimiter=limit=${ceiling.toFixed(3)}:level=false:attack=2:release=80,aresample=48000`,
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "256k", "-movflags", "+faststart", output,
  ]);
  after = loudness(output);
  if (Math.abs(after.I - target) <= 0.5) break;
  gain += 1.6 * (target - after.I); // the limiter absorbs part of every boost
}
const probe = spawnSync(
  "ffprobe",
  ["-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate,nb_frames", "-of", "csv=p=0", output],
  { encoding: "utf8" },
).stdout.trim();
console.log(`in : ${before.I} LUFS, true peak ${before.peak} dBFS`);
console.log(`out: ${after.I} LUFS, true peak ${after.peak} dBFS (gain ${gain.toFixed(2)} dB)`);
console.log(`video: ${probe}`);
if (Math.abs(after.I - target) > 0.5) console.warn(`WARNING: integrated loudness ${after.I} LUFS is more than 0.5 LU from the ${target} LUFS target; report this honestly.`);

==== 1469 project/scripts/gl.mjs
// WebGL renderer choice for headless Chrome, shared by every render script.
// Order: GL env var > the project's .gl-mode file > "angle" (GPU). When the GPU path cannot create a WebGL
// context (no GPU, some VMs/drivers), the scripts switch to "swangle" (software, much slower) automatically
// and remember it in .gl-mode, so later renders and `npx remotion render` (remotion.config.ts) use it too.
import fs from "node:fs";

const FILE = ".gl-mode";

// When the GPU path crashes, Remotion may reject an internal "Target closed" promise that nothing awaits.
// That rejection is noise from the dead tab, not a render failure; real errors still reach the caller.
export const tolerateClosedTargets = () =>
  process.on("unhandledRejection", (e) => {
    if (/Target closed/i.test(String(e?.message ?? e))) return;
    console.error(e);
    process.exit(1);
  });

export const glMode = () =>
  process.env.GL || (fs.existsSync(FILE) ? fs.readFileSync(FILE, "utf8").trim() : "") || "angle";

export const isWebGLError = (e) =>
  /webgl|WebGLRenderer|GL context|BindToCurrentSequence|GL_VENDOR = Disabled/i.test(String(e?.stack ?? e?.message ?? e));

export const switchToSoftware = () => {
  fs.writeFileSync(FILE, "swangle\n");
  console.log(
    "\n! GPU 3D rendering is not available on this computer: switched to software rendering (GL=swangle, much slower)." +
      "\n  Saved in .gl-mode; delete that file to try the GPU again.\n",
  );
  return "swangle";
};

==== 16800 project/scripts/make.mjs
// One command from a story to a checked video.
//   node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json [--stills=3,10,18.5] [--preview] [--final] [--no-sound] [--no-qa] [--force]
//
//   1. resolve   story.json (+ words.json, VO envelope) → src/stories/data/<id>.json, regenerate the registry
//   2. direct    compile the story (blocking, acting, shots, sound cues), print the plan; stops on errors
//   3. sound     scripts/sound-story.ts → public/audio/<id>-mix.wav (+ captions out/<id>/<id>.srt)
//   4. render    --stills: contact sheet · --preview: 540×960@30 with audio (landscape 960×540) · --final (default):
//                1080×1920@60 portrait (story "format": "landscape" → 1920×1080@60), mastered to −14 LUFS
//                (interrupted? run the same command again — finished segments are reused)
//   --from=12 --to=30  render only that part of the film (preview / final): a section to review
//   5. QA        scripts/qa.mjs → out/<id>/qa/ (frame scan, sync, loudness, sheets)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const flag = (k) => args.includes(`--${k}`);
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file)) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/make.mjs stories/<id>/story.json [--stills=…] [--preview] [--final] [--no-sound] [--no-qa]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const step = (s) => console.log(`\n▶ ${s}`);
const sh = (cmd, a, opts = {}) => {
  const r = spawnSync(cmd, a, { stdio: "inherit", ...opts });
  if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(`✗ ${cmd} ${a.join(" ")} failed`); process.exit(r.status ?? 1); }
};

// 1 ── resolve ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("resolve story");
const dir = path.dirname(file);
const story = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(story.id ?? "")) { console.error(`story.id "${story.id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
if (typeof story.words === "string") story.words = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, story.words), "utf8"));
if (!Array.isArray(story.words) || !story.words.length) { console.error("story.words is missing (run scripts/transcribe.mjs first)"); process.exit(1); }
// dynamic world: worlds/<name>.world.json (project) or stories/<id>/<name>.world.json, plus every object it
// or the story uses from library/objects and assets/objects (project objects win)
{
  const cands = [path.join(dir, `${story.world}.world.json`), path.join("worlds", `${story.world}.world.json`), path.join("library", "worlds", `${story.world}.world.json`)];
  const wf = cands.find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
  delete story.worldSpec; delete story.objectSpecs;
  if (wf) {
    story.worldSpec = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(wf, "utf8"));
    const objDirs = ["assets/objects", path.join(dir, "objects"), "library/objects"];
    const need = new Set([...(story.worldSpec.objects ?? []).map((o) => o.use), ...(story.worldSpec.scatter ?? []).map((o) => o.use)]);
    const { BUILTIN } = await import(path.resolve("src/gen/objects/builtin-data.ts"));
    story.objectSpecs = [];
    const missing = [];
    for (const id of need) {
      if (BUILTIN[id]) continue;
      const f = objDirs.map((d) => path.join(d, `${id}.json`)).find((x) => fs.existsSync(x));
      if (!f) { missing.push(id); continue; }
      story.objectSpecs.push(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")));
    }
    if (missing.length) { console.error(`✗ objects not found: ${missing.join(", ")} — write assets/objects/<id>.json (see references/cinestory/objects.md) or use a library object`); process.exit(1); }
    console.log(`  world ${wf}: ${(story.worldSpec.rooms ?? []).length} rooms, ${(story.worldSpec.objects ?? []).length} objects, ${(story.worldSpec.scatter ?? []).length} scatters · object specs: ${story.objectSpecs.map((o) => o.id).join(", ") || "built-in only"}`);
  }
}
// branding: only the user's own brand kit (aibijan-brand.json in the project or the story folder); "brand": false
// in story.json switches it off. The logo is copied to public/brand/.
{
  const given = story.brand;
  delete story.brand;
  const kitFile = [path.join(dir, "aibijan-brand.json"), "aibijan-brand.json"].find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
  if (given !== false && kitFile) {
    const kit = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(kitFile, "utf8"));
    const b = { brand: kit.brand, handle: kit.handle, cta: kit.cta, colors: kit.colors, watermark: !!kit.watermark, intro: kit.intro };
    if (kit.logo) {
      const src = path.join(path.dirname(kitFile), kit.logo);
      if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync("public/brand", { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, path.join("public/brand", path.basename(src))); b.logoFile = `brand/${path.basename(src)}`; }
      else console.log(`  ⚠ brand logo ${src} not found — the brand is used without a logo`);
    }
    story.brand = b;
    console.log(`  brand kit ${kitFile}: ${[kit.brand, kit.handle].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}${b.logoFile ? " + logo" : ""}`);
  }
}
const voPath = path.join("public", story.vo?.file ?? "");
if (!story.vo?.file || !fs.existsSync(voPath)) { console.error(`VO not found: ${voPath}`); process.exit(1); }
// VO loudness envelope, 60 per second (mouth flaps for "talk", music ducking hints)
{
  const raw = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", voPath, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", "6000", "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 28 }).stdout;
  const x = new Float32Array(raw.buffer, raw.byteOffset, Math.floor(raw.length / 4));
  const env = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i += 100) { let s = 0; for (let k = i; k < Math.min(x.length, i + 100); k++) s += x[k] * x[k]; env.push(Math.sqrt(s / 100)); }
  const peak = Math.max(...env.slice().sort((a, b) => a - b).slice(Math.floor(env.length * 0.98))) || 1;
  story.voenv = env.map((v) => +Math.min(1, v / peak).toFixed(2));
}
const mix = `audio/${story.id}-mix.wav`;
const willSound = !flag("no-sound");
if (willSound || fs.existsSync(path.join("public", mix))) story.audio = mix;
const writeResolved = () => {
  fs.mkdirSync("src/stories/data", { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(`src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`, JSON.stringify(story));
  const ids = fs.readdirSync("src/stories/data").filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).map((f) => f.replace(/\.json$/, "")).sort();
  const v = (s) => "s_" + s.replace(/-/g, "_");
  fs.writeFileSync("src/stories/registry.ts", `// Generated by scripts/make.mjs — every story in src/stories/data becomes two compositions.\nimport type { Story } from "../director/story.ts";\n${ids.map((id) => `import ${v(id)} from "./data/${id}.json";`).join("\n")}\n\nexport const STORIES: Story[] = [${ids.map((id) => `${v(id)} as unknown as Story`).join(", ")}];\n`);
};
// compositions must not reference a mix that does not exist yet
if (story.audio && !fs.existsSync(path.join("public", story.audio))) { const a = story.audio; delete story.audio; writeResolved(); story.audio = a; } else writeResolved();
console.log(`  ${story.id}: ${story.words.length} words, world ${story.world}, cast ${(story.cast ?? []).map((c) => `${c.id} (${c.look})`).join(" + ") || "none"}, ${story.scenes?.length ?? 0} scenes`);

// 2 ── direct ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
step("direct (compile the story)");
const { compile } = await import(path.resolve("src/director/compile.ts"));
let P;
try { P = compile(story); } catch (e) { console.error(`✗ story problems:\n${String(e.message).split("\n").map((l) => "  - " + l).join("\n")}`); process.exit(1); }
console.log(`  ${P.format} ${P.format === "portrait" ? "1080×1920" : "1920×1080"} · duration ${P.duration}s · ${P.scenes.length} scenes · ${P.shots.length} shots · ${P.ui.length} overlays · ${P.captions.length} caption lines · ${P.sound.sfx.length} SFX · ${P.sound.steps.length} footsteps`);
for (const s of P.shots) console.log(`  ${s.t0.toFixed(2).padStart(6)}–${Math.min(s.t1, P.duration).toFixed(2).padEnd(6)} sc${s.scene + 1} ${P.scenes[s.scene].place.id.padEnd(8)} ${s.kind.padEnd(10)} ${s.who ?? "-"}${s.target ? " → " + s.target : ""}`);
for (const w of P.warnings) console.log(`  ⚠ ${w}`);
const outDir = path.join("out", story.id);

// 2b ── geometry preflight (objects, marks, bodies, cameras, continuity) — before any render
step("preflight (geometry QC)");
{
  const { preflight } = await import(path.resolve("src/director/preflight.ts"));
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const pf = preflight(P);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.join(outDir, "qa"), { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "preflight.json"), JSON.stringify(pf, null, 1));
  for (const e of pf.errors) console.log(`  ✗ ${e.check}: ${e.msg}`);
  for (const w of pf.warnings) console.log(`  ⚠ ${w.check}: ${w.msg}`);
  console.log(`  ${pf.errors.length} errors · ${pf.warnings.length} warnings · ${Object.entries(pf.stats).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v}`).join(" · ")} · ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)} s → ${path.join(outDir, "qa", "preflight.json")}`);
  if (pf.errors.length && !flag("force")) { console.error("✗ preflight found geometry errors — fix the world/story (or --force to render anyway)"); process.exit(1); }
}
fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "shots.json"), JSON.stringify({ duration: P.duration, voOffset: P.offset, shots: P.shots.map((s) => ({ kind: s.kind, who: s.who, target: s.target, scene: s.scene, t0: s.t0, t1: Math.min(s.t1, P.duration) })) }, null, 1));
// captions (.srt): sentences from the VO words, in film time
{
  const W = story.words, cues = [];
  let cur = [];
  const flush = () => { if (cur.length) cues.push([cur[0][1] + P.offset, cur[cur.length - 1][2] + P.offset, cur.map((w) => w[0]).join(" ")]); cur = []; };
  W.forEach((w, i) => { cur.push(w); const next = W[i + 1]; if (/[.?!]$/.test(w[0]) || cur.length >= 12 || (next && next[1] - w[2] > 0.6)) flush(); });
  flush();
  const ts = (t) => { const ms = Math.round(t * 1000), h = Math.floor(ms / 3600000), m = Math.floor(ms / 60000) % 60, s = Math.floor(ms / 1000) % 60; return `${String(h).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")},${String(ms % 1000).padStart(3, "0")}`; };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, `${story.id}.srt`), cues.map((c, i) => `${i + 1}\n${ts(c[0])} --> ${ts(c[1])}\n${c[2]}\n`).join("\n"));
}

// 3 ── sound ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (willSound) {
  step("sound");
  sh("node", ["--max-old-space-size=4096", "scripts/sound-story.ts", `src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`]);
  writeResolved();
}

// 4 ── render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const stills = opt("stills");
if (stills) {
  step("stills");
  const all = stills.split(",").map((x) => parseFloat(x)).filter((x) => Number.isFinite(x));
  const ok = all.filter((x) => x >= 0 && x < P.duration - 0.05);
  if (ok.length < all.length) console.log(`  (skipped stills past the end of the ${P.duration}s film: ${all.filter((x) => !ok.includes(x)).join(", ")})`);
  if (!ok.length) { console.error("✗ no stills inside the film"); process.exit(1); }
  sh("node", ["scripts/stills.mjs", path.join(outDir, "stills"), ok.map((x) => `${x}s`).join(","), `${story.id}-preview`]);
}
const preview = flag("preview"), final = flag("final") || (!preview && !stills);
let video = null;
const portrait = P.format === "portrait";
const size = portrait ? "1080x1920" : "1920x1080";
const from = opt("from"), to = opt("to");
const range = from || to ? [Math.max(0, Number(from || 0)), Math.min(P.duration, Number(to || P.duration))] : null;
if (preview) {
  step(`render preview (${portrait ? "540×960" : "960×540"} @ 30, with audio)${range ? ` ${range[0]}–${range[1]} s` : ""}`);
  video = path.join(outDir, `${story.id}_preview${range ? `_${range[0]}-${range[1]}s` : ""}.mp4`);
  sh("npx", ["remotion", "render", `${story.id}-preview`, video, "--codec=h264", "--crf=22", `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "4")}`, ...(range ? [`--frames=${Math.round(range[0] * 30)}-${Math.round(range[1] * 30) - 1}`] : [])]);
}
if (final) {
  step(`render final (${portrait ? "1080×1920" : "1920×1080"} @ 60, H.264 + AAC, −14 LUFS)${range ? ` ${range[0]}–${range[1]} s` : ""}`);
  const seg = path.join(outDir, "seg"), stamp = path.join(seg, "story.json");
  const resolved = fs.readFileSync(`src/stories/data/${story.id}.json`, "utf8");
  if (!fs.existsSync(stamp) || fs.readFileSync(stamp, "utf8") !== resolved) fs.rmSync(seg, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(seg, { recursive: true });
  fs.writeFileSync(stamp, resolved);
  video = path.join(outDir, `${story.id}_${size}_60fps${range ? `_${range[0]}-${range[1]}s` : ""}.mp4`);
  sh("node", ["scripts/render-final.mjs", `--comp=${story.id}-final`, `--out=${video}`, `--vo=public/${mix}`, "--offset=0", `--parts=${opt("parts", range ? "2" : "6")}`, `--concurrency=${opt("concurrency", "3")}`, `--seg=${seg}${range ? `-${range[0]}-${range[1]}` : ""}`, ...(range ? [`--from=${range[0]}`, `--to=${range[1]}`] : [])]);
}

// 5 ── QA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if (video && !flag("no-qa")) {
  step("QA");
  sh("node", ["scripts/qa.mjs", video, `--vo=${voPath}`, `--offset=${range ? P.offset - range[0] : P.offset}`, `--expect=${range ? range[1] - range[0] : P.duration}`, `--shots=${path.join(outDir, "shots.json")}`, `--size=${size}`, ...(range ? [`--from=${range[0]}`] : []), ...(final ? ["--final"] : [])]);
  // visual review gate: automated checks never see a post through a face — a person has to look.
  // REVIEW.md stays "PENDING" until every row is filled; never call the video QA PASS before that.
  const pf = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "preflight.json"), "utf8"));
  const rows = ["object clipping / sinking", "floating objects", "people inside objects or each other", "feet / hands / contact plausible", "camera inside walls or blocked view", "continuity across cuts (position, props, light)", "frame errors (black / white / frozen / flicker)", "VO sync and pauses kept", "every object reads as what the script says", "story logic: nothing seen before its reveal, nothing left after it leaves", "no head / back of head covering > 1/4 of a frame (except close-ups)", ...(portrait ? ["text inside the safe area, never over a face (captions, tags, cards, titles)", "faces and key objects readable on a phone (not too dark)"] : []), "pacing: no long stretch of one view / one graphic; reactions on the words"];
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "REVIEW.md"), [
    `# Visual review — ${story.id} (${path.basename(video)})`, "", "STATUS: PENDING VISUAL REVIEW", "",
    `Look at EVERY page of the 1-fps contact sheet — ${(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "qa.json"), "utf8")).contactPages ?? []).map((p) => `${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s)`).join(", ") || "contact_1fps_*.jpg"} — one tile per second, left→right then top→bottom; together they cover the whole video — and shots_start_mid_end.jpg (open the video for anything doubtful). Tick each page below.`, "", ...(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir, "qa", "qa.json"), "utf8")).contactPages ?? []).map((p) => `- [ ] ${p.file} (${p.from}–${p.to} s) seen`), "", "Then fill every row with PASS / FIX + what you saw. Set STATUS to PASS only when no FIX is left.", "",
    "| check | verdict | notes |", "|---|---|---|", ...rows.map((r) => `| ${r} | | |`), "",
    `## Preflight (${pf.errors.length} errors, ${pf.warnings.length} warnings) — confirm each on screen`, "",
    ...(pf.errors.length + pf.warnings.length ? [...pf.errors, ...pf.warnings].map((w) => `- [ ] ${w.level === "error" ? "ERROR" : "warn"} ${w.check}: ${w.msg}`) : ["- none"]), "",
  ].join("\n"));
  console.log(`  review gate → ${path.join(outDir, "qa", "REVIEW.md")} (PENDING until a visual review is written)`);
}
console.log(`\n✓ done${video ? `: ${video}` : ""}`);

==== 2444 project/scripts/objects.mjs
// Object library tools.
//   node scripts/objects.mjs            regenerate src/gen/objects/registry.ts (library/objects + assets/objects)
//   node scripts/objects.mjs --sheet [ids]   …and render a look sheet: every object from two angles next to a
//                                             1.8 m person for scale → out/look/objects/_sheet.jpg
// Project objects (assets/objects/<id>.json) override library ones with the same id.
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";

const dirs = ["library/objects", "assets/objects"];
const files = [];
for (const d of dirs) if (fs.existsSync(d)) for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".json")).sort()) files.push(path.join(d, f));
const byId = new Map();
const problems = [];
for (const f of files) {
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8"));
    if (!j.id || !Array.isArray(j.parts)) { problems.push(`${f}: needs "id" and "parts"`); continue; }
    if (path.basename(f, ".json") !== j.id) problems.push(`${f}: file name should be ${j.id}.json`);
    byId.set(j.id, f);
  } catch (e) { problems.push(`${f}: ${e.message}`); }
}
const v = (s) => "o_" + s.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi, "_");
const list = [...byId.entries()];
fs.writeFileSync("src/gen/objects/registry.ts", `// Generated by scripts/objects.mjs — every object JSON in library/objects and assets/objects.\nimport type { ObjectSpec } from "../spec.ts";\n${list.map(([id, f]) => `import ${v(id)} from "../../../${f}";`).join("\n")}\n\nexport const OBJECTS: ObjectSpec[] = [${list.map(([id]) => `${v(id)} as unknown as ObjectSpec`).join(", ")}];\n`);
console.log(`objects: ${list.length} (${list.map(([id]) => id).join(", ")})`);
for (const p of problems) console.log(`  ⚠ ${p}`);
const want = process.argv.includes("--sheet");
if (want) {
  const ids = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => !a.startsWith("--")).flatMap((a) => a.split(",")).filter(Boolean);
  const all = (await import(path.resolve("src/gen/objects/builtin-data.ts"))).BUILTIN;
  const names = ids.length ? ids : [...list.map(([id]) => id), ...Object.keys(all)];
  fs.writeFileSync("src/gen/objects/sheet-list.json", JSON.stringify(names));
  const frames = names.flatMap((_, i) => [i * 2, i * 2 + 1]).join(",");
  const r = spawnSync("node", ["scripts/stills.mjs", "out/look/objects", frames, "object-sheet"], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(r.status ?? 0);
}

==== 12702 project/scripts/qa.mjs
// Automated QA of a rendered video. Writes out/<id>/qa/{qa.json, contact_1fps_001.jpg …, shots_start_mid_end.jpg}
// (the 1-fps contact sheet covers the whole video in pages of 96 seconds, each tile stamped with its second)
// and prints PASS/FAIL per check. The contact sheets are for the visual review that follows.
//   node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=public/audio/x.mp3 --offset=0.4 --expect=49.8 [--shots=out/<id>/shots.json] [--final]
//                       [--size=1080x1920] [--from=12]   (--from: the video is a section starting at that film second)

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const video = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const final = args.includes("--final");
if (!video || !fs.existsSync(video)) { console.error("usage: node scripts/qa.mjs <video.mp4> --vo=… --offset=… --expect=… [--shots=…] [--final]"); process.exit(1); }
const run = (c, a) => spawnSync(c, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 30 });
const qaDir = path.join(path.dirname(video), "qa");
fs.mkdirSync(qaDir, { recursive: true });
const checks = [];
const check = (name, ok, detail) => { checks.push({ name, ok, detail }); console.log(`  ${ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL"}  ${name}: ${detail}`); };

// streams
const probe = JSON.parse(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_streams", "-show_format", "-of", "json", video]).stdout);
const v = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "video"), a = probe.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === "audio");
const dur = Number(probe.format.duration), expect = Number(opt("expect", dur));
const [fn, fd] = v.r_frame_rate.split("/").map(Number);
const fps = fn / fd;
const [sw, shh] = opt("size", "1920x1080").split("x").map(Number);
const portraitV = shh > sw;
// previews are half size; finals must be the exact delivery size at 60 fps
const sizeOk = final ? v.width === sw && v.height === shh && Math.abs(fps - 60) < 0.01 : Math.abs(v.width / v.height - sw / shh) < 0.01;
check("video stream", v.codec_name === "h264" && sizeOk, `${v.codec_name} ${v.width}×${v.height} @ ${fps} fps${final ? ` (final must be ${sw}×${shh} @ 60)` : ` (${portraitV ? "portrait" : "landscape"} aspect)`}`);
check("audio stream", !!a && a.codec_name === "aac", a ? `${a.codec_name} ${a.sample_rate} Hz, ${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} s` : "missing");
check("duration", Math.abs(dur - expect) < 0.12, `${dur.toFixed(2)} s (expected ${expect.toFixed(2)} s)`);
if (a) check("audio length = video length", Math.abs(Number(a.duration ?? dur) - dur) < 0.15, `${Number(a.duration ?? dur).toFixed(2)} vs ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);

// frame scan: white / black / sudden flashes
const ylog = path.join(qaDir, "yavg.txt");
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `scale=192:108,signalstats,metadata=mode=print:file=${ylog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const ytxt = fs.readFileSync(ylog, "utf8");
const y = (ytxt.match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)));
// 90th percentile luma per frame (video range: black is 16) — a frame whose p90 stays ≤ 24 is practically black
const y90 = (ytxt.match(/YHIGH=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(6)));
// black: the opening fade, scene fades and the end card may be dark on purpose — only long runs fail
const white = y.filter((x) => x > 225).length;
// blown highlights: share of the picture burnt to white (a lamp in close-up, bloom) — the mean luma misses it
const hlog = path.join(qaDir, "hot.txt");
// the middle of the frame (a bright sky at the top is not a lamp in the lens); video range: white is 235
run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", video, "-vf", `crop=iw*0.7:ih*0.6:iw*0.15:ih*0.2,scale=160:120,lutyuv=y='if(gt(val,222),255,0)',signalstats,metadata=mode=print:key=lavfi.signalstats.YAVG:file=${hlog}`, "-f", "null", "-"]);
const hot = (fs.readFileSync(hlog, "utf8").match(/YAVG=[\d.]+/g) ?? []).map((s) => Number(s.slice(5)) / 255);
let hr = 0, hotLongest = 0, hotAt = -1;
hot.forEach((x, i) => { hr = x > 0.12 ? hr + 1 : 0; if (hr > hotLongest) { hotLongest = hr; hotAt = (i - hr + 1) / fps; } });
let run0 = 0, longest = 0;
y.slice(Math.round(fps * 0.9), y.length - Math.round(fps * 1.2)).forEach((x) => { run0 = x < 7 ? run0 + 1 : 0; longest = Math.max(longest, run0); });
const black = longest > fps * 0.7 ? longest : 0;
check("no white frames", white === 0, `${white} frames with mean luma > 225`);
check("no blown-out highlights", hotLongest < fps * 0.5, hotLongest ? `${(hotLongest / fps).toFixed(1)} s with > 12 % of the middle of the picture burnt white (from ${(hotAt + Number(opt("from", 0))).toFixed(1)} s) — a lamp / bloom too close` : "none");
check("no black gaps (outside fades)", black === 0, `longest near-black run ${(longest / fps).toFixed(2)} s (fails above 0.7 s)`);
// frozen picture (a stuck render shows as identical frames)
const fz = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", video, "-vf", "scale=320:180,freezedetect=n=0.0006:d=2.5", "-an", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
const freezes = [...fz.matchAll(/freeze_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1])).filter((t) => t > 1 && t < dur - 6);
check("no frozen picture", freezes.length === 0, freezes.length ? `frozen from ${freezes.map((t) => t.toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : "none (≥ 2.5 s)");
// loudness (final delivery is mastered to −14 LUFS, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP)
if (a) {
  const lu = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-nostats", "-i", video, "-vn", "-af", "ebur128=peak=true", "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
  const I = Number((lu.match(/I:\s+(-?[\d.]+) LUFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  const TP = Number((lu.match(/Peak:\s+(-?[\d.]+) dBFS/g) ?? []).pop()?.match(/-?[\d.]+/)?.[0]);
  check("loudness", !final || (Math.abs(I + 14) < 1.2 && TP <= -0.8), `${I.toFixed(1)} LUFS integrated, true peak ${TP.toFixed(1)} dBTP${final ? " (target −14 LUFS, ≤ −1 dBTP)" : ""}`);
}
const jumps = [];
for (let i = 1; i < y.length; i++) if (Math.abs(y[i] - y[i - 1]) > 45) jumps.push(+(i / fps).toFixed(2));
console.log(`  info  luma ${Math.min(...y).toFixed(0)}–${Math.max(...y).toFixed(0)}, big jumps (cuts) at ${jumps.join(", ") || "none"}`);

// VO sync: cross-correlate the film's audio with the VO around the expected offset
const voFile = opt("vo"), off0 = Number(opt("offset", 0)), section = opt("from") !== "";
// a section that starts after the VO has begun: compare with the VO from that point (expected lag 0)
const voSkip = Math.max(0, -off0), off = Math.max(0, off0);
if (voFile && fs.existsSync(voFile)) {
  const SR = 8000;
  const raw = (f, ss = 0) => { const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", ...(ss ? ["-ss", ss.toFixed(3)] : []), "-i", f, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }); return new Float32Array(r.stdout.buffer, r.stdout.byteOffset, Math.floor(r.stdout.length / 4)); };
  const film = raw(video), vo = raw(voFile, voSkip);
  let best = -1, lag = 0;
  for (let L = Math.round((off - 0.25) * SR); L <= Math.round((off + 0.25) * SR); L++) {
    if (L < 0) continue;
    let s = 0, e1 = 0, e2 = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vo.length && i + L < film.length; i += 3) { const p = vo[i], q = film[i + L]; s += p * q; e1 += p * p; e2 += q * q; }
    const c = s / Math.sqrt(e1 * e2 + 1e-12);
    if (c > best) { best = c; lag = L; }
  }
  const err = lag / SR - off;
  check("VO sync", Math.abs(err) < 0.03 && best > 0.6, `VO found at ${(lag / SR).toFixed(3)} s (expected ${off.toFixed(3)}, error ${(err * 1000).toFixed(0)} ms, correlation ${best.toFixed(2)})`);
  const voEnd = off + vo.length / SR;
  if (!section) check("VO not cut", voEnd <= dur + 0.02, `VO ends at ${voEnd.toFixed(2)} s, video ${dur.toFixed(2)} s`);
}

// contact sheets (portrait: tall tiles): one tile per second for the WHOLE video, 96 per page
// (contact_1fps_001.jpg, _002.jpg …), every tile stamped with its film second so nothing can be skipped unseen
const tw = portraitV ? 180 : 320, thh = portraitV ? 320 : 180;
const grid = portraitV ? [12, 8] : [8, 12], perPage = grid[0] * grid[1];
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(qaDir)) if (/^contact_1fps(_\d+)?\.jpg$/.test(f)) fs.rmSync(path.join(qaDir, f));
// a second stamp on each tile when this ffmpeg has drawtext (not every build does); the page ranges are always listed
const hasDrawtext = /drawtext/.test(run("ffmpeg", ["-hide_banner", "-filters"]).stdout ?? "");
const fontFile = ["/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf", "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf", "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", "C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf"].find((f) => fs.existsSync(f));
const t0s = Number(opt("from", 0));
const stamp = hasDrawtext && fontFile ? `,drawtext=fontfile='${fontFile}':text='%{eif\\:t+${t0s}\\:d}s':x=6:y=6:fontsize=${portraitV ? 22 : 20}:fontcolor=yellow:box=1:boxcolor=black@0.6` : "";
const sheetArgs = (sync) => ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", video, "-vf", `fps=1,scale=${tw}:${thh}${stamp},tile=${grid[0]}x${grid[1]}`, ...sync, "-start_number", "1", path.join(qaDir, "contact_1fps_%03d.jpg")];
// one output image per full (or last, partial) page: -fps_mode on ffmpeg ≥ 5.1, -vsync on older builds
if (run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-fps_mode", "passthrough"])).status !== 0) run("ffmpeg", sheetArgs(["-vsync", "0"]));
const pages = fs.readdirSync(qaDir).filter((f) => /^contact_1fps_\d+\.jpg$/.test(f)).sort();
const needPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.floor(dur) / perPage));
const pageRanges = pages.map((f, i) => ({ file: f, from: Math.round(t0s + i * perPage), to: Math.round(t0s + Math.min(dur, (i + 1) * perPage)) }));
check("contact sheet covers the whole video", pages.length >= needPages, `${pages.length} page(s) of ${perPage} s for ${dur.toFixed(1)} s: ${pageRanges.map((p) => `${p.file} ${p.from}–${p.to} s`).join(", ")}${stamp ? "" : " (tiles not stamped: this ffmpeg has no drawtext — tiles run left→right, top→bottom, one per second)"}`);
const shotsFile = opt("shots");
const from = Number(opt("from", 0));
if (shotsFile && fs.existsSync(shotsFile)) {
  const { shots: all } = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(shotsFile, "utf8"));
  // shots of this video (a section: only those inside it, in video time)
  const shots = all.map((s) => ({ ...s, t0: Math.max(0, s.t0 - from), t1: Math.min(dur, s.t1 - from) })).filter((s) => s.t1 - s.t0 > 0.2);
  // phone readability: the middle of every shot must not sink into black (night ≠ unreadable)
  const dark = shots.filter((s) => { const i = Math.round(((s.t0 + s.t1) / 2) * fps); return y[i] !== undefined && y[i] < 22 && !(s.t0 < 1); });
  // a shot that is practically black for its whole length shows nothing on a phone (darkness needs a sliver of light)
  const black = shots.filter((s) => { if (s.t1 - s.t0 < 1.4 || s.t0 < 1 || s.t1 > dur - 1) return false; const a = Math.round((s.t0 + 0.3) * fps), b = Math.round((s.t1 - 0.3) * fps); const seg = y.slice(a, b); return seg.length && Math.max(...y90.slice(a, b)) <= 24; });
  check("readable on a phone (not too dark)", dark.length <= Math.max(1, Math.floor(shots.length * 0.15)) && black.length === 0, `${dark.length}/${shots.length} shots with mid-frame mean luma < 22${dark.length ? ` (at ${dark.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s)` : ""}${black.length ? ` · ${black.length} practically black shot(s) at ${black.map((s) => (s.t0 + from).toFixed(1)).join(", ")} s` : ""}`);
  const tmp = path.join(qaDir, "tmp");
  fs.mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true });
  let n = 0;
  for (const s of shots) for (const f of [0.12, 0.5, 0.88]) {
    const t = Math.min(dur - 0.05, s.t0 + (s.t1 - s.t0) * f);
    run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", t.toFixed(3), "-i", video, "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", `scale=${tw}:${thh}`, path.join(tmp, `f${String(n++).padStart(3, "0")}.png`)]);
  }
  const cols = portraitV ? 9 : 6;
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-pattern_type", "glob", "-i", path.join(tmp, "f*.png"), "-vf", `tile=${cols}x${Math.ceil(n / cols)}`, "-frames:v", "1", path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")]);
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log(`  info  ${shots.length} shots sampled at start/middle/end → ${path.join(qaDir, "shots_start_mid_end.jpg")}`);
}
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(qaDir, "qa.json"), JSON.stringify({ video, duration: dur, fps, checks, cutsAt: jumps, contactSheets: pages, contactPages: pageRanges }, null, 1));
const failed = checks.filter((c) => !c.ok);
console.log(failed.length ? `\nQA: ${failed.length} check(s) FAILED — fix before delivering` : `\nQA: all ${checks.length} automated checks passed — now review ${qaDir}/*.jpg`);
process.exit(failed.length ? 3 : 0);

==== 4854 project/scripts/render-final.mjs
// Final delivery, cross-platform and restartable: bundle once, render the composition muted in
// segments (finished segments are kept and skipped when re-run — delete out/seg after a source
// edit), join them, lay the voice-over in at its offset, then master the audio to -14 LUFS.
//   node scripts/render-final.mjs --comp=<id> --out=out/film.mp4 [--vo=public/audio/vo.mp3 --offset=0.4]
//                                 [--parts=3] [--concurrency=2] [--crf=17] [--seg=out/seg] [--from=12 --to=30]
// --from / --to (film seconds) render only that section, with the soundtrack cut to match.
// Bounded concurrency + segments: one-pass high-concurrency 1080p renders have filled disks via swap.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { bundle } from "@remotion/bundler";
import { renderMedia, selectComposition } from "@remotion/renderer";
import { glMode, isWebGLError, switchToSoftware, tolerateClosedTargets } from "./gl.mjs";

tolerateClosedTargets();

const arg = (k, d) => (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const comp = arg("comp"), out = arg("out"), vo = arg("vo"), offset = Number(arg("offset", "0"));
const parts = Number(arg("parts", "3")), concurrency = Number(arg("concurrency", "2")), crf = Number(arg("crf", "17"));
if (!comp || !out) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/render-final.mjs --comp=<id> --out=<file.mp4> [--vo=<audio> --offset=<s>] [--parts=3] [--concurrency=2]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const ff = (a) => {
  const r = spawnSync("ffmpeg", a, { encoding: "utf8" });
  if (r.status !== 0) throw new Error(r.stderr);
};
const segDir = arg("seg", path.join("out", "seg"));
fs.mkdirSync(segDir, { recursive: true });
const serveUrl = await bundle({ entryPoint: path.resolve("src/index.ts") });
const composition = await selectComposition({ serveUrl, id: comp });
const fromS = arg("from"), toS = arg("to");
const F0 = fromS ? Math.max(0, Math.round(Number(fromS) * composition.fps)) : 0;
const F1 = toS ? Math.min(composition.durationInFrames, Math.round(Number(toS) * composition.fps)) : composition.durationInFrames;
const N = F1 - F0;
const count = (f) => Number(spawnSync("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0", "-count_packets", "-show_entries", "stream=nb_read_packets", "-of", "csv=p=0", f], { encoding: "utf8" }).stdout.trim() || 0);
const list = [];
let gl = glMode();
for (let i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
  const a = F0 + Math.floor((N * i) / parts), b = F0 + Math.floor((N * (i + 1)) / parts) - 1;
  const part = path.join(segDir, `part${i}.mp4`);
  list.push(`file 'part${i}.mp4'`);
  if (fs.existsSync(part) && count(part) === b - a + 1) {
    console.log(`part ${i} (${a}-${b}) done, skipping`);
    continue;
  }
  console.log(`part ${i}: frames ${a}-${b}`);
  let shown = 0;
  const tmp = path.join(segDir, `part${i}.tmp.mp4`);
  const renderPart = () => renderMedia({
    composition, serveUrl, codec: "h264", crf, pixelFormat: "yuv420p", muted: true, frameRange: [a, b], outputLocation: tmp,
    concurrency, imageFormat: "jpeg", jpegQuality: 95, chromiumOptions: { gl }, timeoutInMilliseconds: 300000,
    // a line per quarter (a \r counter floods logs that are read by an agent)
    onProgress: ({ progress }) => { const q = Math.floor(progress * 4); if (q > shown) { shown = q; process.stdout.write(`  ${q * 25}%`); } },
  });
  try {
    await renderPart();
  } catch (e) {
    if (gl === "swangle" || !isWebGLError(e)) throw e;
    gl = switchToSoftware();
    await renderPart();
  }
  process.stdout.write("\n");
  fs.renameSync(tmp, part);
}
fs.rmSync(serveUrl, { recursive: true, force: true });
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(segDir, "list.txt"), list.join("\n") + "\n");
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
const dur = (N / composition.fps).toFixed(4);
const joined = path.join(segDir, "joined.mp4");
if (vo) {
  ff(["-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", path.join(segDir, "list.txt"), ...(F0 ? ["-ss", (F0 / composition.fps).toFixed(4)] : []), "-i", vo, "-map", "0:v", "-map", "1:a", "-c:v", "copy",
    "-af", `adelay=${Math.round(offset * 1000)}:all=1,apad`, "-t", dur, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "320k", "-ar", "48000", joined]);
  const r = spawnSync("node", [path.join("scripts", "deliver.mjs"), joined, out], { stdio: "inherit" });
  if (r.status !== 0) process.exit(r.status ?? 1);
} else {
  ff(["-v", "error", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", path.join(segDir, "list.txt"), "-c", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", out]);
}
fs.rmSync(segDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log(`final: ${out} (${N} frames, ${composition.width}×${composition.height} @ ${composition.fps} fps)`);
// a part that failed on the GPU path leaves its timeout timer behind; do not wait for it
process.exit(0);

==== 19943 project/scripts/sound-story.ts
// Automatic sound department for any CINÉSTORY story. Compiles the story exactly like the picture, then
// lays ambience per place (and per set state: lamps, beams, boats…), footsteps from the walk cycles, SFX
// per action / set change / story cue, a score per scene mood with hits, risers and strategic silence,
// and mixes it all under the untouched voice-over (ducked). All synthesised: no samples, no licences.
//   node scripts/sound-story.ts src/stories/data/<id>.json   → public/audio/<id>-mix.wav

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { compile } from "../src/director/compile.ts";
import type { Story } from "../src/director/story.ts";
import {
  Bus, S, SR, bell, biquad, boom, breath, click, creak, dbg, decode, doorClose, doorOpen, drone, duckEnvelope, envAR, envExp, ep, foghorn, freeverb,
  gull, heartbeat, kalimba, knock, noise, pad, pink, pluck, radio, riser, rng, rustle, scribble, shimmer, sine, smooth, subPulse, thud, waveCrash, whoosh, writeWav, type Out,
} from "./synth.ts";

const file = process.argv[2];
if (!file) { console.error("usage: node scripts/sound-story.ts src/stories/data/<id>.json"); process.exit(1); }
const story = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8")) as Story;
const P = compile(story);
const SP = P.sound;
const DUR = SP.duration, N = Math.round(DUR * SR);
const amb = new Bus(N), music = new Bus(N), sfx = new Bus(N), verb = new Bus(N);
const M: Out = { dry: music, verb }, F: Out = { dry: sfx, verb }, A: Out = { dry: amb, verb };
const R = rng(2026);

// ── set state, sampled (lamps, beams, boats change the ambience) ───────────
const STEP = 0.05;
const states = Array.from({ length: Math.ceil(DUR / STEP) + 1 }, (_, k) => P.setAt(k * STEP));
const st = (i: number, k: string) => states[Math.min(states.length - 1, Math.floor(i / SR / STEP))]?.[k] ?? 0;

// ── 1. ambience ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
{
  const ids = [...new Set(SP.amb.map((a) => a.id))];
  const G: Record<string, Float32Array> = Object.fromEntries(ids.map((k) => [k, new Float32Array(N)]));
  const dark = new Float32Array(N);
  for (const a of SP.amb) {
    const d = { night: 1, storm: 1, dusk: 0.6, dawn: 0.35, day: 0 }[a.time] ?? 1;
    for (let i = S(a.t0); i < Math.min(N, S(a.t1)); i++) { G[a.id][i] = 1; dark[i] = d; }
  }
  for (const g of [...Object.values(G), dark]) { let s = g[0]; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { s += (g[i] - s) * 0.0008; g[i] = s; } }
  const has = (k: string) => G[k] !== undefined;
  const g0 = (k: string, i: number) => (G[k] ? G[k][i] : 0);
  const bed = (seed: number, f: (x: Float32Array) => Float32Array, gain: (i: number) => number, g: number, pan: number) => {
    const x = f(pink(N, seed));
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) x[i] *= gain(i);
    amb.add(0, x, g, pan);
  };
  // the sea: slow swells (periods 7–11 s) of surf, close (sea), below the cliff (coast), far (gallery), muffled (cottage)
  const swell = (i: number) => { const t = i / SR; return 0.55 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 0.71) + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 0.43 + 1.3); };
  if (has("coast") || has("gallery") || has("cottage") || has("sea")) {
    bed(11, (x) => biquad(x, "lp", 520), (i) => swell(i) * (0.55 * g0("coast", i) + 0.3 * g0("gallery", i) + 0.35 * g0("cottage", i) + 0.45 * g0("sea", i)), 0.6, -0.1);
    bed(12, (x) => biquad(biquad(x, "hp", 900), "lp", 5200), (i) => swell(i) ** 2 * (0.12 * g0("coast", i) + 0.05 * g0("gallery", i) + 0.18 * g0("sea", i)), 0.5, 0.15);
    // crashes on the rocks
    for (let t = 1.5 + R() * 3; t < DUR; t += 6 + R() * 4) {
      const i = S(t), w = 0.5 * g0("coast", i) + 0.25 * g0("gallery", i) + 0.18 * g0("cottage", i);
      if (w > 0.05) waveCrash(A, t, 0.3 * w, R() * 1.2 - 0.6, g0("cottage", i) > 0.5 ? 1 : 0.4);
    }
    // water lapping on a hull (out at sea)
    if (has("sea")) for (let t = 0.3; t < DUR; t += 0.35 + R() * 0.6) { const w = g0("sea", S(t)); if (w < 0.05) continue; const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.25), Math.round(t * 100)), "bp", 380 + R() * 500, 1.5), 0.06, 0.005); amb.add(t, x, 0.5 * w, R() * 1.4 - 0.7); }
  }
  // wind: gusting band of noise; a whistle on the gallery railing; low and muffled indoors
  if (has("coast") || has("gallery") || has("cottage") || has("sea")) {
    const gust = (i: number) => { const t = i / SR; return 0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 0.37 + 2) + 0.2 * Math.sin(t * 1.13); };
    bed(21, (x) => biquad(x, "bp", (i) => 500 + 400 * gust(i), 0.6), (i) => gust(i) * (0.28 * g0("coast", i) + 0.55 * g0("gallery", i) + 0.18 * g0("sea", i)), 0.55, 0.25);
    bed(22, (x) => biquad(x, "lp", 260), (i) => gust(i) * 0.35 * g0("cottage", i), 0.5, 0.1);
    bed(23, (x) => biquad(x, "bp", (i) => 1150 + 260 * gust(i), 6), (i) => gust(i) ** 3 * 0.5 * g0("gallery", i), 0.4, -0.3);
  }
  // crickets in the grass at night (outside, faint indoors)
  {
    const L = new Float32Array(N), Rr = new Float32Array(N);
    for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
      const r = rng(100 + c), f = 4100 + r() * 1000, rate = 0.5 + r() * 0.5, pan = r() * 1.6 - 0.8;
      for (let t = r(); t < DUR; t += rate * (0.85 + r() * 0.3)) for (let p = 0; p < 3; p++) {
        const o = S(t + p * 0.045), n = S(0.03);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * f * i) / SR) * Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / n) * 0.5; if (o + i < N) { L[o + i] += x * Math.cos(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); Rr[o + i] += x * Math.sin(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); } }
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const k = dark[i] > 0.7 ? (g0("coast", i) + 0.15 * g0("cottage", i) + 0.4 * g0("outdoor", i) + 0.15 * g0("room", i) + 1.2 * g0("forest", i)) * (dark[i] - 0.7) / 0.3 : 0; L[i] *= k; Rr[i] *= k; }
    amb.addSt(0, L, Rr, 0.02);
  }
  // gulls by day / dawn on the coast or at sea
  for (let t = 2 + R() * 3; t < DUR; t += 3 + R() * 5) { const i = S(t); const w = (1 - dark[i]) * (g0("coast", i) + g0("sea", i) + 0.4 * g0("gallery", i)); if (w > 0.25) gull(A, t, 0.05 * w, R() * 1.6 - 0.8); }
  // the lighthouse lamp: motor hum + clockwork tick when the beam turns
  if (has("coast") || has("gallery") || has("cottage")) {
    const x = new Float32Array(N);
    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const t = i / SR, b = st(i, "beam"); const w = b * (0.06 * g0("coast", i) + 0.5 * g0("gallery", i) + 0.02 * g0("cottage", i)); x[i] = w * (Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 60 * t) * 0.5 + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 120 * t) * 0.25 + Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 180 * t) * 0.1); }
    amb.add(0, x, 0.05, 0.1);
